{{Quote|Gerrard V is attempting to gain its independence, but the Imperial governor is looting the city. Rogue Squadron, you must protect Crix Madine's Y-wings while they disable the escaping ships.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan's]] briefing to the Rebel squadrons|<ref name="RS I" />}}
An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''governor''' ruled the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Gerrard V]]. More than [[0 ABY/Legends|six]] [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] plotted to smuggle the planet's riches away from the people of Gerrard V, many of whom were [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] supporters.<ref name="RS I guide">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron: The Official Nintendo Player's Guide]]''</ref> He placed the the loot aboard luxury [[Yacht/Legends|yachts]]. The Alliance sent its elite flight groups [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] and [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]], which [[Liberation of Gerrard V|disabled]] the yachts and stopped the cowardly governor's plot.<ref name="RS I" />

==Behind the scenes==
The governor was first mentioned in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']] [[Star Wars video games|video game]],<ref name="RS I guide" /> released [[December 1]], [[1998]].<ref name="RS I" /> Although the [[1994]] magazine [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 3|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 3]] identifies [[Dannal]] as the governor of Gerrard V during an earlier [[Uprising on Gerrard V|uprising]],<ref name="AJ 3">{{JournalCite|3|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref> the video game does not indicate that they are the same individual.<ref name="RS I guide" />
